Execute.SQL: select t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT, t.CREATED_DATE, t.TRANSACTION_ID, p.POLNUMBER, r.REQ_ACCT_NUM from CRLTRANSACTION t inner join POLICY p on t.TRANSACTION_ID=p.TRANSACTION_ID inner join REQ_INFO r on p.POLICY_ID=r.POLICY_ID where t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM is null and (sysdate - t.CREATED_DATE) > (1.0/24.0) and to_date(t.CREATED_DATE) > ADD_MONTHS( to_date(sysdate), -2) and t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT in ('PACT','AIGP','PRUX','LADDER','TDEX','AIGL','ELFP','AXA') and r.REQ_INFO_ID not in (1021,1022) ORDER BY T.TRANSACTION_ID DESC

SELECT distinct t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT, t.CREATED_DATE, t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM, t.TRANSACTION_ID, p.POLNUMBER, r.REQ_ACCT_NUM FROM CRLTRANSACTION T, POLICY P, REQ_INFO R WHERE T.TRANSACTION_ID = P.TRANSACTION_ID AND P.POLICY_ID = R.POLICY_ID AND T.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM IS NOT NULL AND T.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM <> 'INVALID' AND T.TRANSACTION_ID NOT IN (SELECT PP.TRANSACTION_ID FROM POLICY PP, REQ_INFO RR, STATUS SS WHERE SS.REQ_INFO_ID = RR.REQ_INFO_ID AND PP.POLICY_ID=RR.POLICY_ID AND T.TRANSACTION_ID=PP.TRANSACTION_ID) AND (sysdate - t.CREATED_DATE) > 1.0 AND to_date(t.CREATED_DATE) > ADD_MONTHS( to_date(sysdate), -2) AND T.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT in ('PACT','AIGP','PRUX','LADDER','TDEX','AIGL','ELFP','AXA') AND r.REQ_INFO_ID not in (1021,1022) ORDER BY T.TRANSACTION_ID DESC

select t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT, t.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE, t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM, p.POLNUMBER, (select count(*) from ATTACHMENT where STATUS_ID is not null and CRL_DOCUMENT_ID is not null and TRANSACTION_ID=t.TRANSACTION_ID) as AVAILABLE, (select count(*) from ATTACHMENT where STATUS_ID is not null and TRANSACTION_ID=t.TRANSACTION_ID) as EXPECTED, (select LISTAGG(TRANSACTION_ID||'-'||ATTACHMENT_ID||'-'||nvl(CRL_FILENAME, 'filename.pdf'),',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ATTACHMENT_ID) AS FILENAMES from ATTACHMENT where TRANSACTION_ID=t.TRANSACTION_ID and STATUS_ID is not null and CRL_DRAWER_NAME='SFTP' AND CRL_DOCUMENT_ID is null) as EXPECTED_FILENAMES from CRLTRANSACTION t inner join POLICY p on t.TRANSACTION_ID=p.TRANSACTION_ID where t.AWAITING_ATTACHMENTS='Y' AND t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM <> 'INVALID' and t.PF_PROCESSING_KEY is null and (sysdate - t.CREATED_DATE) > 1.0 and to_date(t.CREATED_DATE) > ADD_MONTHS( to_date(sysdate), -2) and t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT in ('PACT','AIGP','PRUX','LADDER','TDEX','AIGL','AIGP','AXA') and p.POLICY_ID not in (select r.POLICY_ID from REQ_INFO r where r.POLICY_ID=p.POLICY_ID and r.REQ_ACCT_NUM in (1021,1022)) ORDER BY t.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE DESC

select t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT, t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM, p.POLNUMBER, t.PF_PROCESSING_KEY from CRLTRANSACTION t inner join POLICY p on t.TRANSACTION_ID=p.TRANSACTION_ID where t.PF_PROCESSING_KEY is not null and t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM <> 'INVALID' and (t.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE < (sysdate - interval '1' hour) or (t.FINAL_RESULT_DELIVERED_DATE is null and (t.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE < sysdate - interval '1' hour))) and to_date(t.CREATED_DATE) > ADD_MONTHS( to_date(sysdate), -2) and t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT in ('PACT','AIGP','PRUX','LADDER','TDEX','AIGL','ELFP','AXA') and p.POLICY_ID not in (select r.POLICY_ID from REQ_INFO r where r.POLICY_ID=p.POLICY_ID and r.REQ_ACCT_NUM in (1021,1022)) ORDER BY T.TRANSACTION_ID DESC

select t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT, t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM, p.POLNUMBER, r.REQ_STATUS, t.PF_PROCESSING_KEY, (select min(s.STATUS_EVENT_DATE) from STATUS s where s.REQ_INFO_ID=r.REQ_INFO_ID and s.MESSAGE_SENT_DATE is null) as ACTIVITY_DATE, (select LISTAGG(s.PROVIDER_EVENT_CODE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.STATUS_ID) FROM STATUS s where s.REQ_INFO_ID=r.REQ_INFO_ID and s.MESSAGE_SENT_DATE is null ) as PROVIDER_EVENT_CODES from CRLTRANSACTION t inner join policy p on t.TRANSACTION_ID=p.TRANSACTION_ID inner join REQ_INFO r on p.POLICY_ID=r.POLICY_ID where (sysdate - T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE) > 1.0 and to_date(t.CREATED_DATE) > ADD_MONTHS( to_date(sysdate), -2) and r.REQ_INFO_ID in (select s.REQ_INFO_ID from STATUS s WHERE s.MESSAGE_SENT_DATE is null and s.FLOWNET_ID is not null and t.PF_PROCESSING_KEY is null and t.AWAITING_ATTACHMENTS = 'N' and t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM <> 'INVALID' and s.PROVIDER_EVENT_CODE <> 'S82' and s.PROVIDER_EVENT_CODE <> '901' and s.STATUS_EVENT_DETAIL not like '%check #%') and t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT in ('PACT','AIGP','PRUX','LADDER','TDEX','AIGL','ELFP','AXA') and r.REQ_ACCT_NUM not in (1021,1022) order by t.TRANSACTION_ID desc, r.REQ_INFO_ID asc
